message:
feat(release): the planner prints the gate commands from the base

The builder command read gates-linux.scoped.json from the checkout that held the
script, so a branch could edit the command that judges it. It now reads the file
where the branch left trunk, prints a line for each gate the change edited,
added or removed, and refuses to print commands when trunk has no gates file.
An explicit --gates-json still wins.

Verified: node --test gate-defs, planner-from-base, gate-scope 50 of 50 pass, tools.test 22 of 22 pass, red log qa/verification-article/s5s4/logs/s5-1-red.log

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(release): deleted test lines earn no budget

A file that lost lines used to subtract from the change's net, so deleting a
test bought room for another. A file with a positive net is credited, a file
below zero adds to the deleted count and credits nothing, and a change that
deletes test lines fails with the count and the files unless an allowance row
names at least that many lines. Report mode and the enforce default are
unchanged. A rename counts as lines gained and lines deleted.

Verified: node --test test-budget 40 of 40 pass (1 known todo), red log qa/verification-article/s5s4/logs/s5-2-red.log

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(release): verification stamp in observe mode

Each commit says how it was verified in a Verified trailer, or Verified: none
(reason). The planner command and the seal print how many commits in the
range have none and list their shas. The mode file
scripts/personal/qa/verify-stamp.json is read from the change's base and
defaults to observe when missing; a malformed file also observes, with a
warning. Enforce exits 2 in the planner and refuses the seal. Merge commits
and release version and notes commits (a chore or docs release subject that
touches only release files) need no stamp.

Verified: node --test verify-stamp 33 of 33 pass, red logs qa/verification-article/s4/logs s4-red.log and s4-red-cli.log

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(release): the planner reads gate commands from the base, the budget and the stamp

Verified: none (readme text only, the behaviour is tested in the commits above)
